newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Cambodia ready to receive ASEAN mission - Malaysia.
newsitem.headline: Cambodia ready to receive ASEAN mission - Malaysia.

text.p: Malaysian Foreign Minister Abdullah Badawi said on Tuesday he had received a letter from Cambodian Foreign Minister Ung Huot welcoming an ASEAN mediation mission to Phnom Penh.
Abdullah said the letter, dated July 29, had been faxed to Kuala Lumpur. He said he had been told on Monday to expect the fax.

Indonesian Foreign Minister Ali Alatas, who is heading the three-member mediation mission from the Association of South East Asian Nations (ASEAN), said the letter "welcomed ASEAN's help to restore political stability in Cambodia".
"These are the words used by Mr Hun Sen (contained in the faxed letter from Ung Huot) and these are the words agreed upon for us to use without going into details," Alatas told reporters.
He said he hoped the mission, which also includes the foreign ministers of Thailand and the Philippines, would go to Phnom Penh soon, but a precise date still had to be agreed.
